rule: Identify the originating source as Tango Time Travel; do not replace native source provenance with an external reference.
evidence_basis: TTT source collection and existing source-profile work

rule: Preserve the complete original source path; the file is an asset, not the recording itself.
Preserve hierarchy as source evidence; extract semantic values only where a TTT hierarchy rule is established.
Create a Source Collection assertion from a recognized TTT collection node; retain the original path.
Retain filename verbatim; decode sequence/title/take components only where the filename grammar rule matches.
Carry the TTT title as a source assertion for the composition/title identity; do not treat title equality as entity identity.
Extract the text before the native TTT slash as the ensemble assertion.
evidence_basis: TTT comparison sample: native artist values use Ensemble / participant form; source archaeology

rule: Extract the text after the native TTT slash as the performer expression; do not interpret the Instr. marker as a person.
evidence_basis: TTT comparison sample: native artist values use Ensemble / participant form

rule: When the participant expression uses the TTT conjunction y, expose individual participant candidates after the slash while retaining the original expression.
evidence_basis: TTT comparison sample: F. Fiorentino y A. Mandarino

rule: Derive instrumental status from the TTT participant marker Instr.; do not create a Person entity for Instr.
evidence_basis: TTT comparison sample; historical validation rule

rule: Retain the complete native artist expression as a source assertion even when decomposition is incomplete.
Preserve album_artist as source evidence; use it as corroborating ensemble evidence rather than assuming it establishes leadership.

source_pattern: composer component before optional Lyrics clause
rule: Extract the composer component from the native metadata_composer field, stopping before an embedded Lyrics clause.
evidence_basis: TTT comparison sample: metadata_composer contains composer and Lyrics in one field

rule: Expose composer names joined by y as candidate components only where the conjunction grammar is clear; downstream entity management reconciles names.
evidence_basis: TTT comparison sample: José y Luis Servidio

rule: Extract the lyricist from the native embedded Lyrics clause; do not require a separate author source field.
evidence_basis: TTT comparison sample and compound-field archaeology

rule: Extract parenthetical text as identity/name evidence without creating a separate Person solely from parentheses.

source_pattern: Record / Matrix / Take labeled compound identifier
rule: Decode labeled components without interpreting the internal identifier syntax; values such as S-5242-A and 621/53 are preserved intact.
Preserve the complete native catalog field as the authoritative source representation even after component extraction.
Preserve the record component as an identifier assertion; do not equate it automatically with a Recording entity.
Preserve matrix number as identity evidence; do not collapse it into a recording ID without reconciliation.
Preserve take number as a separate concept; do not assume it uniquely identifies a recording.
Represent the supplied date with its supported precision; do not manufacture precision.
Preserve the TTT genre value and map it only through an explicit vocabulary crosswalk; do not collapse TTT's richer vocabulary to a downstream DJ vocabulary.
evidence_basis: TTT genre inventory; Common Model architecture

rule: Resolve as a Person candidate only when TTT context establishes that the performer is a person; retain source wording.
Create a Person candidate with conductor credit; entity resolution remains downstream.
Map through MusicStewardship media vocabulary while preserving the original TTT value.
Treat album as a Release/package context, not as recording identity.
Preserve source track position within the release context.
Expose semicolon-delimited clauses while retaining the raw comment. Unrecognized clauses remain source evidence and are not discarded.
Extract A4 concert-pitch evidence from a recognized clause.
Extract supplied performance/asset key separately from score key; retain transposed wording in the raw source comment.
Extract supplied score key independently from the recorded key.
Extract arranger credit from recognized Arreglador clause; retain original comment as evidence.
evidence_basis: TTT comparison sample: Inspiración and Maragata

rule: Extract the erroneous label matrix value as an explicit source assertion; never overwrite the stated matrix value.

source_pattern: embedded Lyrics clause in composer field
rule: Derive lyrics presence from recognized Lyrics evidence in the native composer field; do not pretend has_lyrics is a native TTT field.
Derive instrumental status from the native TTT artist field.
evidence_basis: TTT baseline; Instr. is embedded in metadata_artist

rule: Preserve technical properties as properties of the Source Asset; they do not define the Recording entity.
Retain as external corroborating evidence; never make reference matching an acceptance gate.
Keep external values as separate evidence; native TTT values remain primary source-derived evidence.

source_pattern: anything not covered by an established rule
rule: Do not discard. Preserve the original value and identify it as residual/uninterpreted until a future rule accounts for it.
